ui.meta.pointer.a11y: Learn how the Garage earns race perks
ui.meta.sheet.title: Lab Rep perks
ui.meta.sheet.body: Lab Rep is your account level. It comes from shipping models in the Garage and from finishing races, and it is never spent. Race perks are small on purpose: a head start, not a cheat code.
ui.meta.sheet.zero: You have no Lab Rep yet. Ship your first model in the Garage (or finish a race) to earn the first perk.
ui.meta.sheet.toggleHint: Off: a clean start, the same as everyone else.
ui.meta.end.reward: Garage: +{rep} Lab Rep · blueprints ×{mult} for {minutes} min
ui.meta.end.none: Garage: nothing more from this world
ui.meta.note.title: From your last race
ui.meta.note.win: You won. The Garage got +{rep} Lab Rep.
ui.meta.note.lose: You lost, but learned. The Garage got +{rep} Lab Rep.
ui.meta.note.boostOver: The blueprints boost has run out.
